statement: theorem take_theorem (s₁ s₂ : ωSequence α) (h : ∀ n : ℕ, take n s₁ = take n s₂) : s₁ = s₂ :=
proof_text:
by
  ext n
  induction n with
  | zero => simpa [take] using h 1
  | succ n =>
    have h₁ : some (s₁ (succ n)) = some (s₂ (succ n)) := by
      rw [← getElem?_take_succ, ← getElem?_take_succ, h (succ (succ n))]
    injection h₁
gold_proof:
by
  ext n
  induction n with
  | zero => simpa [take] using h 1
  | succ n =>
    have h₁ : some (s₁ (succ n)) = some (s₂ (succ n)) := by
      rw [← getElem?_take_succ, ← getElem?_take_succ, h (succ (succ n))]
    injection h₁

theorem extract_eq_drop_take {xs : ωSequence α} {m n : ℕ} :
    xs.extract m n = take (n - m) (xs.drop m) :=

theorem extract_eq_ofFn {xs : ωSequence α} {m n : ℕ} :
    xs.extract m n = List.ofFn (fun k : Fin (n - m) ↦ xs (m + k)) :=
proof_text:
by
  ext k; cases Decidable.em (k < n - m) <;>
  grind [extract_eq_drop_take, getElem?_take]
gold_proof:
by
  ext k; cases Decidable.em (k < n - m) <;>
  grind [extract_eq_drop_take, getElem?_take]

proof_text:
by
  simp only [extract_eq_ofFn, List.ofFn_inj', Sigma.mk.injEq] at h
  obtain ⟨h_eq, h_fun⟩ := h
  rw [← h_eq] at h_fun
  simp_all [funext_iff, Fin.forall_iff]
gold_proof:
by
  simp only [extract_eq_ofFn, List.ofFn_inj', Sigma.mk.injEq] at h
  obtain ⟨h_eq, h_fun⟩ := h
  rw [← h_eq] at h_fun
  simp_all [funext_iff, Fin.forall_iff]

theorem extract_eq_take {xs : ωSequence α} {n : ℕ} :
    xs.extract 0 n = xs.take n :=

theorem append_extract_drop {xs : ωSequence α} {n : ℕ} :
    (xs.extract 0 n) ++ω (xs.drop n) = xs :=

theorem extract_append_right_right {xl : List α} {xs : ωSequence α} {m n : ℕ} (h : xl.length ≤ m) :
    (xl ++ω xs).extract m n = xs.extract (m - xl.length) (n - xl.length) :=

theorem extract_append_zero_right {xl : List α} {xs : ωSequence α} {n : ℕ} (h : xl.length ≤ n) :
    (xl ++ω xs).extract 0 n = xl ++ (xs.extract 0 (n - xl.length)) :=
proof_text:
by
  obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ : ∃ k, n = xl.length + k := ⟨n - xl.length, by omega⟩
  simp [extract_eq_take, ← append_take]
gold_proof:
by
  obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ : ∃ k, n = xl.length + k := ⟨n - xl.length, by omega⟩
  simp [extract_eq_take, ← append_take]

theorem extract_drop {xs : ωSequence α} {k m n : ℕ} :
    (xs.drop k).extract m n = xs.extract (k + m) (k + n) :=

theorem length_extract {xs : ωSequence α} {m n : ℕ} :
    (xs.extract m n).length = n - m :=

theorem extract_eq_nil {xs : ωSequence α} {n : ℕ} :
    xs.extract n n = [] :=

theorem extract_eq_nil_iff {xs : ωSequence α} {m n : ℕ} :
    xs.extract m n = [] ↔ m ≥ n :=

theorem get_extract {xs : ωSequence α} {m n k : ℕ} (h : k < n - m) :
    (xs.extract m n)[k]'(by simp [h]) = xs (m + k) :=

theorem append_extract_extract {xs : ωSequence α} {k m n : ℕ} (h_km : k ≤ m) (h_mn : m ≤ n) :
    (xs.extract k m) ++ (xs.extract m n) = xs.extract k n :=
proof_text:
by
  have : n - k = (m - k) + (n - m) := by grind
  grind [extract_eq_drop_take, take_add]
gold_proof:
by
  have : n - k = (m - k) + (n - m) := by grind
  grind [extract_eq_drop_take, take_add]

theorem extract_succ_right {xs : ωSequence α} {m n : ℕ} (h_mn : m ≤ n) :
    xs.extract m (n + 1) = xs.extract m n ++ [xs n] :=
proof_text:
by
  rw [← append_extract_extract h_mn] <;>
  grind [extract_eq_drop_take, add_tsub_cancel_left]
gold_proof:
by
  rw [← append_extract_extract h_mn] <;>
  grind [extract_eq_drop_take, add_tsub_cancel_left]

theorem extract_lu_extract_lu {xs : ωSequence α} {m n i j : ℕ} (h : j ≤ n - m) :
    (xs.extract m n).extract i j = xs.extract (m + i) (m + j) :=
proof_text:
by
  ext k
  cases Decidable.em (k < j - i) <;> grind [extract_eq_ofFn]
gold_proof:
by
  ext k
  cases Decidable.em (k < j - i) <;> grind [extract_eq_ofFn]

theorem extract_0u_extract_lu {xs : ωSequence α} {n i j : ℕ} (h : j ≤ n) :
    (xs.extract 0 n).extract i j = xs.extract i j :=

theorem extract_0u_extract_l {xs : ωSequence α} {n i : ℕ} :
    (xs.extract 0 n).extract i = xs.extract i n :=

theorem take_extract {xs : ωSequence α} {m n k : ℕ} (h : k ≤ n - m) :
    (xs.extract m n).take k = xs.extract m (m + k) :=

theorem drop_extract {xs : ωSequence α} {m n k : ℕ} (h : k ≤ n - m) :
    (xs.extract m n).drop k = xs.extract (m + k) n :=
proof_text:
by
  have := extract_lu_extract_lu (xs := xs) (m := m) (n := n) (i := k) (j := n - m)
  grind [length_extract, List.take_length]
gold_proof:
by
  have := extract_lu_extract_lu (xs := xs) (m := m) (n := n) (i := k) (j := n - m)
  grind [length_extract, List.take_length]

theorem cumLen_zero {ls : ωSequence (List α)} :
    ls.cumLen 0 = 0 :=

theorem cumLen_succ (ls : ωSequence (List α)) (k : ℕ) :
    ls.cumLen (k + 1) = ls.cumLen k + (ls k).length :=

theorem cumLen_one_add_drop (ls : ωSequence (List α)) (k : ℕ) :
    ls.cumLen (1 + k) = (ls 0).length + (ls.drop 1).cumLen k :=

theorem cumLen_strictMono {ls : ωSequence (List α)} (h_ls : ∀ k, (ls k).length > 0) :
    StrictMono ls.cumLen :=

theorem cumLen_segment_zero {ls : ωSequence (List α)} (h_ls : ∀ k, (ls k).length > 0)
    (n : ℕ) (h_n : n < (ls 0).length) : segment ls.cumLen n = 0 :=
proof_text:
by
  have h0 : ls.cumLen 0 ≤ n := by simp [cumLen_zero]
  have h1 : n < ls.cumLen 1 := by simpa [cumLen_succ, cumLen_zero]
  exact segment_range_val (cumLen_strictMono h_ls) h0 h1
gold_proof:
by
  have h0 : ls.cumLen 0 ≤ n := by simp [cumLen_zero]
  have h1 : n < ls.cumLen 1 := by simpa [cumLen_succ, cumLen_zero]
  exact segment_range_val (cumLen_strictMono h_ls) h0 h1
